prompt: Check that every systemd service is active (systemctl is-active), disk usage (df -BG) and recent errors (journalctl --since yesterday -p err). Give a short structured summary and end your reply with exactly 'STATUS: OK' or 'STATUS: PROBLEM'.
description: Daily 7am health check. Only pings the channel when the output matches notifyPattern (remaining: 0 = runs forever).

prompt: Report the expiry date of every Let's Encrypt certificate (certbot certificates) and tell me if any renews in less than 20 days.
description: One-shot reminder on the 25th at 9am. Runs once then deletes itself (remaining: 1). No notifyPattern means it always notifies.
